In the world of traditional archery, precision, comfort, and
craftsmanship are essential. Vermil’s Padauk Wood Thumb Rings
bring these elements together in a way that redefines what archery
gear can achieve. Designed for archers of all levels, these rings
combine natural beauty with advanced craftsmanship, offering an
unparalleled shooting experience.
Why Padauk Wood Stands Out
Lightweight and Luxurious
One of the most significant advantages of Padauk wood is its weight.
Vermil’s Padauk rings are 20% lighter than their resin counterparts,
making them easier to control and more comfortable to use during
long shooting sessions. But it’s not just about performance—
Padauk’s natural reddish-brown tones and intricate grain patterns
exude a sense of luxury and uniqueness, ensuring no two rings are
ever the same.
Strength Meets Elegance
Padauk wood offers the perfect balance between density and
strength. It’s sturdy enough to withstand the pressure of thumb
release while remaining lightweight for effortless handling. Its natural
resistance to moisture further enhances its durability, ensuring your
ring stays beautiful and functional over time.

How to Care for Your Padauk
Thumb Ring
To maintain the beauty and functionality of your ring:
1. Clean regularly: Use a dry cloth to remove dirt or moisture after
each use.
2. Avoid excessive humidity: Store your ring in a dry place to
prevent unnecessary exposure to moisture.
3. Reapply beeswax: If the ring begins to feel dry, applying a layer of
natural beeswax will restore its finish and protect it from wear.
